text: Of 412 Madinah complaints in September, 151 are about late delivery and 88 about a missed call before arrival.
The most repeated complaint is from a customer who asks to be called back on 0500012030 about two missed attempts.

The late parcels of the week cluster on one driver, identity number 1000106936, on the evening shift.
Two customers left numbers in their complaints: 0500043706 and 0500051625.
